test_title: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 17 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following letter-clusters should replace # and % so that the pattern and relationship followed between the letter-cluster pair on the left side of :: is the same as that on the right side of :: ?

# : RWS :: INJ : %
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bd3c600bf09d7de25d7d22479d848ddead62c9f7437c41312681e3719e85d12d.png] 

Given:

# : RWS :: INJ : %

Analysis of Options:

**Option 1) # = UZV , % = FKG**

**For # (UZV) to RWS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d2df7b67a3011bbd548fc8c21a1837ab04a78ffefe403dd69ce17eb213275403.png] 

The pattern derived from UZV to RWS is: (-3, -3, -3).

**For INJ to % (FKG)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a41e635445f88b6f36aab1a944045919ae2e7ece85a82493efad806e811efe2d.png] 

The pattern derived from INJ to FKG is: (-3, -3, -3).

**Option 2) # = NGV , % = FLP**

**For # (NGV) to RWS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/155beb22f59657a3acc4348bba93a9909c828bd574767a2d6f339da7350ebf3a.png] 

The pattern derived from NGV to RWS is: (+4, +16, -3).

**For INJ to % (FLP)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e5007b90aa949725017ce5e12d695b824867a4987b0e2292f5e7f90e575be6a7.png] 

The pattern derived from INJ to FLP is: (-3, -2, +6).

Since the pattern for NGV to RWS (+4, +16, -3) is not the same as the pattern for INJ to FLP (-3, -2, +6), Option 2 is incorrect.

**Option 3) # = CDR , % = KJI**

**For # (CDR) to RWS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ac206e194710132f028c4b0672629822d60fa966b611fb443e45404b53a2ebaa.png] 

The pattern derived from CDR to RWS is: (+15, +19, +1).

**For INJ to % (KJI)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/46e82583866caca0d05dc0ec376f1e1cb826be6b3cc72df07967c384962880d9.png] 

The pattern derived from INJ to KJI is: (+2, -3, -1).

Since the pattern for CDR to RWS (+15, +19, +1) is not the same as the pattern for INJ to KJI (+2, -3, -1), Option 3 is incorrect.

**Option 4) # = PIV , % = MJU**

**For # (PIV) to RWS**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/02992ef713f48bc191b9e4dffe599dc37ab080f0a1cd0625925e29f59667c1bb.png] 

The pattern derived from PIV to RWS is: (+2, +14, -3).

**For INJ to % (MJU)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1d8fa6e6295e33d6214394d8af27c8b8b690d9aafa2c5cfc7f000f9a7cca1d9e.png] 

The pattern derived from INJ to MJU is: (+4, -4, +11).

Since the pattern for PIV to RWS (+2, +14, -3) is not the same as the pattern for INJ to MJU (+4, -4, +11), Option 4 is incorrect.

Thus, the analogy holds true only for **Option 1** where the pattern (-3, -3, -3) is consistent for both pairs.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 1"**.
